class: A secret in a log line
symptom: The Gmail reader logged the first 60 characters of the mail row it found; a subject such as "Your verification code is 482913" put the one-time code in the log.
root_cause: A log line quoted the content of a message that carries a secret. safety.redact masks keys, passwords, emails and phone numbers, not a short code, so nothing downstream caught it.
why_tests_missed: The no-secrets-in-logs test replaced the Gmail reader with a fake, so the line that logged the preview never ran.
fix: The line now says only that a code was found.
prevention: Never log the content of a message, page or field that can carry a secret; log that something happened. Test secrets-in-logs against the real reader on a stand-in inbox, not against a fake of it.
